Following the duplicate-invoice rule: invoice 602 is paid (P) and was entered first, so keep 602 and void 801. The journal that recorded 801 is 2488. Reversing every line of 2488 means posting the opposite sides in an open period.

Journal 2488 lines: DR 5200 4013.64, DR 5400 5464.72, CR 2000 9478.36. The reversal is CR 5200 4013.64, CR 5400 5464.72, DR 2000 9478.36. I'll post it in open period 11 (the period of the original journal, which is open), so the reversal is in the same period as the original.

Checking balance: the reversal debits 9478.36 and credits 9478.36, so it balances on its own. The net effect across 2488 and the reversal is zero, and the invoice remains voided.
